impact: VAL-CAP-006 (N-008 row 181, smoke / must-pass / regression, M1 / 1080p60 / NVENC) failed its leg 1 criterion ("declared frame count produced even while source window is minimised or behind another window for the full 60 s") during retry-2 execution on 2026-05-22T18:54:27→18:58:50Z. Leg 2 (HUD timer increments) passed. Net row verdict: BLOCKED on leg 1 → must-pass red blocking T-010c §22 smoke. Evidence: ffprobe on the v2 export file at `${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/cove-screen-recorder/exports/exp-1779476330387946665-0003.mp4` (87 122 333 bytes; ISO MP4 / h264 / 3840x2160 / r_frame_rate=120/1 / avg_frame_rate≈43.08 fps / duration=27.856178s / nb_read_frames=1200 = nb_read_packets=1200). Per N-008 §6.1 line 409, declared frame count = round(duration × declared_fps) = round(27.856 × 60) = 1671 at the UI preset's declared 60 fps; 1200 actual = 71.8% of declared, deficit 28%. Earlier draft of the row's evidence file (.story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-22-t-010c-slice-3-m1-smoke-completion-retry-2/operator-evidence/VAL-CAP-006/) marked the row PASS by re-interpreting through VAL-EXP-011's "real cadence preserved" lens; Codex review 2026-05-22T16:43:28 (Issue #1) correctly rejected that re-interpretation. Test conditions during the failure run: (a) source actually captured at 3840x2160 (DP-4 had been pre-flight-set to 1920x1080@60 via kscreen-doctor at slice start but KDE-Plasma auto-restored its preferred 3840x2160@240 mode at some point before/during the capture; no `capture.formatChanged` notification observed in the helper slice), (b) DMA-BUF negotiation hard-failed on both portal sessions in the row (18:54:27.103Z + 18:57:17.648Z); helper transparently fell back to SHM, (c) the Cove window was occluded for ≥60 s of the recording window per row procedure (operator-confirmed coverage maneuver; HUD jumped from 00:05 to 01:15 across the cover-and-restore sequence). Possible root causes to triage: (i) KWin's PipeWire screencast natively throttles frame emission when the source compositor surface is occluded and the desktop is largely idle — frames may be supply-limited at the compositor boundary, in which case this is documented Wayland behavior and the criterion may need refinement for occluded-source rows; (ii) SHM fallback's per-frame copy overhead may not sustain 60 Hz at 4K; (iii) the helper's NVENC encoder may not be receiving frames at nominal rate when running against a 4K source under SHM. Re-test conditions to disambiguate: rerun VAL-CAP-006 at confirmed 1920x1080@60 source (kscreen-doctor verified at row start AND just before save), Cove visible during coverage (replace minimise with another fullscreen window layered above; allow KWin to keep compositing the captured display so frame supply isn't supply-limited), fresh DMA-BUF path (restart helper with cleared restore token to force fresh portal handshake; verify DMA-BUF succeeds before relying on its frame rate). If at 1080p60 + DMA-BUF + occluded-but-active compositor the helper still misses declared count by more than the §6.1 ±5% 99th percentile budget, this is a real capture/encoder defect; if it passes, the original failure may be a test-environment artifact specific to 4K+SHM+idle-compositor. Owner-on-fail layer per N-008 §3: capture / encoder. Distinct from ISS-008 (no v2 UI callers — this row reached the v2 path successfully). A renderer engine.onReady subscription race was also investigated mid-pass and would have warranted its own ISS, but per operator authorization on 2026-05-22 it was not filed this pass (the prompt's "at most one new ISS-XXX.json" budget is reserved for this issue as the first must-pass row red); the race investigation is preserved in evidence at .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-22-t-010c-slice-3-m1-smoke-completion-retry-2/blocker-initial-ready-race/ and may be filed in a follow-up pass if it resurfaces. Evidence paths: .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-22-t-010c-slice-3-m1-smoke-completion-retry-2/operator-evidence/VAL-CAP-006/{BLOCKED.md,ffprobe-frame-count.txt,helper-log-excerpt.txt,hud-during-minimised.png,source-minimised.png}. This issue is the single new ISS filed this pass, within the prompt's "at most one new ISS-XXX.json" budget.
